mechanism: Amphotericin B causes nephrotoxicity and electrolyte disturbances (hypokalemia, hypomagnesemia) that impair codeine metabolism and increase CNS depression risk; codeine may mask fever used to monitor amphotericin B efficacy.
action: Monitor renal function, electrolytes, and CNS status closely; consider alternative analgesics with less metabolic dependence; avoid codeine if possible during amphotericin B therapy.
